limitations: Reviewed YouTube fixtures are exposed regression data, not an independent test set.
Candidate intervals include partial footage and repeated highlight excerpts; unique complete battle count is not established.
Source-frame verification checks encoding and alignment, not battle identity or detector recall.
New layouts, hidden headers, rapid edits, and unlabelled replays require further validation.
Protected official sources remain reserved; new cuts from them must not be used to fit recognition or tracking parameters.
